_about: This studio's own formats, merged over Video Octopus's built-in ones (core/pipelines.json in the app). A format is matched by id (tutorial, short, explainer, or a new id with its own label and steps). Its styles are added, or replaced when the id matches; blocks and steps are replaced when given; defaultStyle picks the style new projects start with. Example: {"formats": {"short": {"styles": [{"id": "my-reel", "label": "My reel", "skill": "my-reel-skill", "hint": "what it looks like"}], "defaultStyle": "my-reel"}}}
